messages:
rachel: flagging an incident  CI runner logs (public gist) accidentally included service account json for svc-ci-runner@redwood-prod. found by external scanner. treat as confirmed leak.
omar: thanks. do we know which runs included it? gist shows a build output from last week.
dina: initial telemetry: we saw two token exchanges using that SA in the last 36h against our metrics project. low volume but active. we'll need a coordinated rotation and RBAC tightening.
rachel: constraints: this SA is used by multiple CI clusters across projects (prod, staging, partners). ripping it immediately will break builds. we need a canary-first approach and a short-lived token flow via iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator.
infra-bot: created draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1201 which adds new vault kv path secret/ci/svc-ci-runner/v2 and replaces project-level editor bindings with scoped service account roles.
sre-oncall: replication note: Vault is in active-active with eventual consistency window up to 2m under load. plan includes replication verification before revoke.
audit-pipeline: recommend exporting Create/DeleteServiceAccountKey and KMS rewrap events to longterm bq table security.rotations_ci_4125009999. filter suggestion: protoPayload.methodName:("CreateServiceAccountKey" OR "DeleteServiceAccountKey" OR "google.cloud.kms.v1.CryptoKeyVersion.AsymmetricSign") AND resource.labels.service_account_id:svc-ci-runner
oman: (typo) omar: also check cloud asset inventory for any copies of the JSON in bucket snapshots or container images. run `gcloud asset search-all-resources --query='name:svc-ci-runner'` and path scans.
dina: proposed runbook: 1) generate new keypair, 2) encrypt with KMS (BYOK? maybe not), 3) store in Vault transit-wrapped KV at v2, 4) roll canary to 10% CI traffic via feature flag, 5) after 20m of stable runs, promote and revoke old key. include rollback: re-enable old key for 15m if failures >3%.
rachel: KMS note: we're contemplating switching the CI SA to a customer-managed KMS key (BYOK) to align with partner requirements. that requires compliance signoff and may change rewrap semantics. do we need to involve them now?
compliance-bot: yes: BYOK or any key policy changes touching EU-hosted data require pre-approval. for now, if we keep GCP-managed KMS and only use Vault transit wrapping, open a brief notification ticket with audit export attached. escalate if BYOK chosen.
infra-bot: added RBAC delta in PR: remove roles/editor and add roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for the CI orchestrator service accounts in each project; add roles/logging.viewer scoped to pipelines project for troubleshooting.
omar: scan plan: run rg and trufflehog across monorepo and docker layers: `rg "private_key\": \"-----BEGIN" --hidden --iglob '!node_modules'` and `trufflehog filesystem --max_depth 4 .` plus a container registry scan for layers containing the JSON.
audit-pipeline: pre-exported 30d of related audit logs into security.rotations_ci_4125009999 and will keep the canary window appended for 90d.
sre-oncall: replication check command for Vault: `vault read sys/replication/status | jq .` ensure active clusters show applied_index progression > last_write_index. wait until sync is within 3s.
dina: minimal rotation commands for staging (will paste to PR):
```
# create new key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-ci-key.json --iam-account=svc-ci-runner@redwood-prod
# encrypt with KMS (optional)
#gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring ci-keys --key ci-runner-key --plaintext-file=new-ci-key.json --ciphertext-file=new-ci-key.enc
# write into vault (transit wrap)
vault write transit/rotor plaintext=@new-ci-key.json
vault kv put secret/ci/svc-ci-runner/v2 key_cipher=@ciphertext
# bump CI feature flag to 10% and smoke test
kubectl set env deployment/ci-orchestrator CI_CANARY=10 -n cicd
```
rachel: owners: rachel=incident lead, dina=rollout+runbook, omar=scans+asset inventory, audit-pipeline=log export, infra-bot=PR+RBAC, sre-oncall=replication+smoke tests. scheduled staging test Mon 11:00 PT, prod canary Tue 07:30 PT, full promote Tue 08:30 PT if green.
omar: after revoke, run repo-wide artifact scan and container registry scan; also run a post-rotate pass to detect lingering base64 blobs that match JSON key patterns. sample regex: "private_key"\s*:\s*"-----BEGIN"
compliance-bot: please attach vendor confirmations if any partners were involved and include the KMS decision in the ticket. retention requirement: rotation export must be kept 1 year for audits.
rachel: will open the compliance notification with links to PR and audit export. thanks all 44D
